workspaceMemoryRole.is: Authorized Workspace Envelope data role (MEMORY.md / memory/*.md root)

memoryAsset.identity: Own resourceId; must not equal any Workspace resourceId
memoryAsset.relation: sourceWorkspaceResourceId is association only, never a shared primary key

lifecycle.workspaceIndex: copy/verify/cutover/recovery stay on workspace cutover receipts
lifecycle.memoryAsset: promotion/decay/forget/purge owned by Memory Asset governance
lifecycle.forgetPurge: Must not delete another workspace_id partition (W9)

phase1aAllowed: static tests that the production tree does not implement schema v2
explicitlyForbidden: shared identity between Memory Asset and Workspace
